description: Get the compatibility record for one web feature: Baseline state and the date it crossed, deprecation and standards status, per-browser version added and removed with flags, vendor prefixes and partial-implementation notes, and the MDN and specification links. Accepts a BCD key such as css.selectors.has or a web-features id such as has; the response echoes which one it matched. An unresolved feature returns found: false with guidance rather than an error.

feature.description: A browser-compat-data key such as css.selectors.has, or a web-features id such as has, 1 to 200 characters. An empty or longer string is rejected against this schema; a whitespace-only string returns invalid_feature_input. Call browsercompat_search_features first if you do not already know the key.

include_runtimes.description: Add the bun, deno, nodejs, and oculus rows to support. Leave off for browser ship decisions.

resolve.description: When true, a string that is neither a key nor an id falls back to the search index, such as "Container queries (size)" or "Element.prototype.animate". Its best exact matches are accepted only when they name one feature: a single key resolves to that key, several keys of one web-features feature resolve to the feature with compat_keys, and matches spanning two features are a miss. Off by default so a typo returns a miss you can correct rather than a confident answer about the wrong feature.

subkeys_offset.description: Direct child keys to skip, default 0. Each subkeys page contains at most 100 keys; pass its next_offset to continue.

name: browsercompat_get_feature

baseline.description: Baseline state for the resolved key, or the feature rollup when a web-features id resolved to more than one key.

date_is_upper_bound.description: True when a date above is ≤-prefixed, so it is an upper bound rather than exact.

high_date.description: Date the feature became widely available, verbatim from web-features — may carry a ≤ prefix.

since_date.description: Date the feature became newly available, verbatim from web-features — may carry a ≤ prefix.

state.description: widely and newly are Baseline availability, limited means not yet in every core browser, not_mapped means the key sits outside the web-features mapping.

baselineNotMapped.description: Explains why a resolved key carries no Baseline state.

compat_keys.description: Present when the web-features id spans more than one browser-compat-data key. Call this tool again with one of them for the per-browser fields.

data_version.description: Vintage of each bundled dataset behind this answer.

bcd_generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the browser-compat-data snapshot was generated at.

browserslist.description: Version of the bundled browserslist query resolver.

caniuse_lite.description: Version of the bundled caniuse-lite snapshot.

web_features.description: Version of the bundled web-features snapshot.

description.description: web-features description, or the browser-compat-data description with tags stripped.

discouraged.description: Feature-level discouragement, independent of leaf standards status. Also retained in status.discouraged when status exists.

according_to.description: URLs of the bodies that discourage the feature.

reason.description: Why the feature is discouraged, as web-features states it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_feature_input`: feature is whitespace-only. An empty or over-200-character string is rejected against the input schema instead. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when the feature string resolved to a tracked entry.

guidance.description: What to do next on a miss or with no compat data.

limiting_browser.description: Among the Baseline core browsers, the one requiring the newest release. Present only when every core browser has full, unprefixed, unflagged support at a resolvable added release.

version.description: Release of that browser the feature requires.

mdn_url.description: MDN reference page for the resolved key.

name.description: web-features display name for the feature.

outcome.description: found when per-feature data was returned, no_compat_data when the entry is tracked but owns no browser-compat-data keys, miss when nothing matched.

baseline_id.description: The web-features id this resolved to, or null when no web-features entry covers the key.

bcd_key.description: The single browser-compat-data key this resolved to, or null when the web-features id spans more than one key.

input.description: The feature string as the caller sent it, trimmed.

resolved_via.description: Which step of the resolution order matched: bcd_key or web_features_id for an exact match, web_features_id_normalized when it matched only after lowercasing, redirect when the input pointed to a browser-compat-data entry that has moved or split, or search when resolve was true and the best exact matches in the search index all named one feature or key — treat a search match as a best guess, not a confirmed key.

resolved_as.description: How the feature string was matched, or null on a miss.

runtimesExcluded.description: Notes that the feature carries server-runtime or XR data that was left out.

spec_urls.description: Specification URLs for the resolved key, always an array.

status.description: Standards status for the resolved key. Absent for webextensions keys, which record none, and when the id spans more than one key.

deprecated.description: True when browser-compat-data marks the feature deprecated.

discouraged.description: Present when web-features records that the feature is discouraged.

according_to.description: URLs of the bodies that discourage the feature.

reason.description: Why the feature is discouraged, as web-features states it.

experimental.description: True when browser-compat-data marks the feature experimental.

standard_track.description: True when the feature is part of an active specification process.

subkeys.description: Direct child compat records of the resolved BCD key. Absent for childless keys and resolutions without a single key.

keys.description: At most 100 direct child keys, in BCD traversal order. Call browsercompat_get_feature for one, or browsercompat_check_baseline for up to 20.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page; absent at or past the end.

total.description: Total direct callable child keys, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more direct children remain after this page.

support.description: One row per reported browser. Absent when the id spans more than one browser-compat-data key.

alternative_name.description: Entirely different name the feature is implemented under.

flags.description: Flags gating support in this browser.

items.description: A flag that must be configured for support.

name.description: Name of the flag or preference to configure.

type.description: Whether the gate is a user preference or a runtime flag.

value_to_set.description: Value the flag must be set to.

impl_url.description: Links to bugs or issues tracking the implementation, always an array.

notes.description: Notes from browser-compat-data about this support, always an array.

partial.description: True when the implementation does not meet the mandatory specified behavior.

prefix.description: Vendor prefix the feature ships under.

verdict.description: supported means full support with no flags, prefix, or partial implementation; partial means the implementation does not meet the mandatory specified behavior; prefixed means it ships under a vendor prefix or an entirely different name; flagged means it only works behind a preference or runtime flag; removed means it shipped and was later removed; unsupported means it was never added; preview_only means it only works in a preview channel; unknown means the browser is absent from the data or support predates a ≤ bound — unknown never means unsupported.

version_added_is_upper_bound.description: True when the data says support arrived at or before version_added, not exactly at it.

version_last.description: Last release that still supported the feature.

title: Browsercompat Get Feature
